name: Snoqualmie River (Fall City)
blurb: The Seattle-area summer tubing float below Snoqualmie Falls — short, warm(ish), and crowded on hot weekends.

sections.notes: Very popular with tubers; crowded on hot summer days. Discover Pass required at Plum Landing (WDFW).
sections.mapPendingReason: Fall City Access: Batch 2 (2026-10-25) finding, not promoted: the nearest WDFW access is 'Raging River' (WDFW page https://wdfw.wa.gov/places-to-go/water-access-sites/raging-river-627; 1 concrete ramp, WDFW-managed, no closure). Its WDFW ramp feature (layer 5, 211; 47.567983, -121.882314) is at the south-bank water's edge on imagery (river-left on NHDPlus HR 163859671), but it is a different site from v1's Fall City Access below the SR 202 bridge (47.5696, -121.8882), about 500 m away. Needs a decision on whether to relocate the take-out to Raging River before promotion. Imagery pass (2026-10-25, not promoted): No managing-agency source confirming access was found, so it was not eligible for imagery placement. Label kept unchanged as instructed.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

mapAuditNote: Audited 2026-10-25 (batch 2). Plum Landing is verified (WDFW ramp feature 271). Fall City Access is still pending: the nearest agency ramp is WDFW's Raging River site, ~500 m from v1's point, so it needs a relocation decision.
